text: Hello everyone, nice to see you again.Today we will continue our topic of essay writing.In the last period, we talked about how to plan our writing and enrich our content.Today, our focus is how to add logic to our writing and polish our language.By the end of this period, you are expected to have a clear understanding of how to make word choices, how to craft better sentences, and how to use correct linking words.Do you still remember the four steps in our writing procedure?Our last lesson covered the planning and the drafting part.In this class, we will learn how to revise and edit our writing.What is the order of revising an article?I suggest we start it from the top level, the structure of our essay.For the structure, we check whether the essay is complete or not.Make sure that the thesis statement is well supported by topic sentences and the text that follows.For the paragraph, we may adjust some transitional words or rearrange the order of sentences so that the flow is smooth.If necessary, we should consider adding some information or removing some information.On the sentence and word level, we aim for variety and a strong effect.The chart below may give us a clear idea of the purpose of revising.Let's take this writing task as an example.Please read the directions and circle the keywords.These sentences are taken from students' work.Which do you like?I think all of you will choose wonder and explore.Why do you make this choice?If we compare the definitions in the dictionaries, we will find both words have more descriptive details.They are more specific and concrete.Wonder is a particular way of walk.It is walking slowly without a purpose.Explore is a word related to travel, but we travel with the purpose to learn.The words in the first sentences are called general words.So when we are making revisions, our first job is to identify those general words.This is a paragraph taken from a student's work.Please spot those general words first.How many general words have you found?You may have noticed general words like good, show, people, very, thing and see.Let's begin with the adjective good.Good is a very vague adjective.If we are talking about a suggestion, we can try a practical or useful suggestion.If we are talking about a good trip, we can use the word memorable or pleasant.The word memorable tells readers the trip is good enough to be remembered.The word pleasant informs our readers we really enjoy the trip.A better way of saying a good example is a typical example.Show, on the other hand, is a very general verb.If we show something to the public, we use the word exhibit.If we show something that was previously unknown, we should choose the word reveal.The words demonstrate and display mean putting things somewhere so people can see it clearly and easily.These two words help our readers to understand our context better.We often make the mistake of using the words people or thing in our writing.These words tend to confuse our readers.In the sample paragraph, people should be referred to as visitors and things as the details on the architecture.Next, remove the words very and really in our writing.Very interesting.That is fascinating.Really scared.That is terrified.Run very fast.We can use rush, dash or sprint.Let us spend more time on the word see.We have a group of synonyms we can use.Can you find a replacement here?I suppose you are all familiar with the definitions of the words like browse, scan, watch and glance.What about glimpse?This word means to see something for a moment without getting a complete view.Getting a glimpse into the past of Shanghai means taking a look at the old Shanghai in a very brief manner.Can you think of more words related to the action of seeing something?Let's still take the trip to Shikumen buildings as an example.Please fill in the blanks with a proper word.If a time or place witnesses an event, the event happens.Observe means to see or watch something very carefully.Let me give you one more example.One student performs the experiment while his partner observes.You see, only with observation can we make interesting findings.Spot means noticing something that is hard to see or recognize.Since the architecture is pretty old, the old bricks could only reveal themselves when the outside paint falls off.These old bricks could also be covered with a thick layer of dust.Therefore, it's not easy to see or recognize these old bricks.As you can see from these sentences, careful choice of words adds to the richness of writing and makes it more vivid.These two sentences are taken from the beginning and ending of an essay.Which one do you think is the best choice here?When we are writing a letter to the student union, we won't brainstorm our ideas.Brainstorm means thinking of as many ideas as possible.The next word, tell is a word too general.Do you know the meaning of the word impose?The letter is addressed to the student union and therefore a modest tone should be applied.Impose means forcing ideas upon others and it's not polite.Contribute is the best choice here.It means you are offering help to achieve a purpose.For the ending, the student union will not submit a plan to the students.The word is often used when we give something to a higher authority.The next word convey is related to feelings or detailed information.We all know the word leak.It has negative implications.We normally link the word with some criminal cases or terrible events.Announce is the best choice here.The meaning is to officially tell somebody about something, especially about a plan.Make sure we choose the precise word that fits the context.Do you know how to improve your writing with smart word choices now?First, identify general words.They can be nouns like people or things.They can be adjectives like good or bad.Or they can be verbs like say, walk or see.Next, brainstorm some specific words for replacement.If we have enough time, we can check Thethorus, Tongyi Ci Ci Dian or Colocation Dictionaries, Dapai Ci Dian for inspiration.Then choose the precise word that fits the context.We can compare the context of our sentences with the sentence examples in the dictionary.On your worksheet is printed a sample writing.Please circle the precise words we have talked about.Have you finished your job?We will move up to the sentence level.Please read through the essay again.Underline the beginning part of each sentence.We can start our sentences in different ways.As typical examples, 借词辞组.If time permits, 条件状与重置.As we can imagine, 非现之性定于重置.Why not 反问之?Look at these two sentences.On both sides of the Huangpu River are gorgeously illuminated views.Nothing is better than appreciating the view on the moving deck.We can consider using literary devices like inversion and comparison to vary our sentence structures.Now it's your turn to try to rewrite a sentence with a different sentence opener.Please rewrite the following sentences on your worksheet.For the first sentence, we can also say time permitting 独立主格结构.Or with more time 借词段语.In the second sentence, we have alternative ways of saying as we can imagine.We can use adverbs like unsurprisingly or undoubtedly to lead a sentence.Or we can use formal subject here 形式主语 it.As you can see, using a mixture of different sentence structures reduces repetition and adds emphasis to important points.Short sentences were not overused, can emphasize an idea and catch readers' attention easily.You can see the effect of short sentences from the following examples.To make our text more interesting, we should use different sentence openers, different sentence structures, and different sentence length.So far, we have talked about the methods of refining our language.To make the whole passage logical and coherent, we need one more tool, that is linking words.Linking words help us to connect ideas and sentences.They are like road signs, getting readers prepared for the reason.The example, the additional information, the result, or the summary.With the effective use of linking words, readers will not get lost in the sea of information.How can we use linking words in our writing?Please circle the keywords in the directions.Make sure that you understand the topic.This is the body part of a student's work.Can you find the thesis statement?Now, please add some linking words to make the whole passage more coherent.Here are some linking words that help to get across the complex ideas.When we are introducing the most important reason, we can say primarily because.To highlight the purpose, we say in order to.And when we want to say in order to, we say in order to.And when we want to add some new explanations, we can say moreover, in addition, furthermore, or beyond that.If we need to emphasize a cause, we can use the phrase thanks to.For another example, thanks to modern technology, life is much easier now.The word despite is often used to connect to contrasting ideas.In this passage, the contrasting ideas are benefits and concerns.After learning the linking words in our writing, we have only one job, that is editing.Becoming a good editor takes time, but it's worth the effort.With this checklist, you can communicate your ideas more clearly and you can eliminate the errors.Just remember, review your words point by point.Every time you are checking through your writing, focus on one aim at a time.In the first read, check your positions.Is your position firm?In other words, are all your claims in the thesis statement and topic sentences consistent?In the next read, look at the explanations and examples in the body parts.Are they relevant to the topic sentences?For accuracy, we may check grammar, spelling, and punctuation.Don't forget, we are writing for our readers.Check the tone of your language and make adjustments if it is too casual or if it is too formal.As we mentioned in this period, linking words help to make our essay clear and logic.For linking devices, we also have multiple expressions for the same logic.Choose the impressive ones if possible.If you are alone doing this edition job, please read it aloud after finishing writing.Your ears may pick up the mistakes your eyes have missed.Look at the initial letters of this checklist.What is it?Yes, it is a pearl.A pearl is a highly valued item.It is a decoration in our life.So I hope with this checklist, you can improve the value of your writing.Writing an essay is like composing a symphony.The words in varied sentences are the music notes played by different instruments.Only when they are combined in a harmonious way can we hear a beautiful piece of music.At the end of this unit, let's review what we have talked about.We discussed the four steps in writing and what we should do in each step.More importantly, we learned some skills in enriching the content and polishing the language.That's all for today.Every writing piece is a proof of critical thinking.If you follow the step-by-step approach, writing is not that difficult.However, to improve our writing, we still need a lot of practice.Writing is for sharing ideas.Taking it easy and you will find writing a meaningful task.This is the last unit of the whole online course.Each unit you have learned is like a puzzle piece.You may not realize its significance right now.However, you will see its magic when you have collected all the puzzle pieces.
